item.title: CompTIA SecOT+ (SOT-001): OT Incident Management
item.category: "CompTIA SecOT+ Course" , "OT Incident Management" , "Incident Response" , "PICERL" , "ICS4ICS" , "Digital Forensics" , "Disaster Recovery" , "Operational Technology" , "SOT-001" , "Cybersecurity"
item.description: Master OT incident management from draft CompTIA SecOT+ SOT-001 topics. Learn the PICERL model, ICS4ICS, response plans and playbooks, exercises, OT-specific incident effects like loss of view and control, forensics, and containment through recovery.

item.title: How to Build an Incident Response Program
item.description: Build an incident response program aligned with NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 through authority, severity, evidence, communication, recovery, and exercises.
